data.title: Volaris: Analyst Raises Price Target to $7 but Cites Elevated Valuation and Fuel Risks in Sell/High Risk Call
data.description:
In a report released on November 25, Filipe Nielsen from Citi downgraded Controladora Vuela Compania de Aviacion SAB de CV to a Sell, with a price target of $7.00.

Filipe Nielsen’s rating is based on a combination of stretched valuation, fuel sensitivity, and limited near-term competitive upside. Although he raised the official price target from $6.60 to $7.00 per ADS, he sees the shares as pricing in fuel benefits that would require a much sharper decline than assumed. The recent rally may also have been amplified by short-covering, leaving Volaris trading at an elevated 5.4x EV/EBITDA and vulnerable to a correction.

Weaker peso conditions could hurt international demand and reduce the benefit of stronger domestic performance. While the merger may improve the competitive environment, slower progress and limited capacity overlap mean its immediate upside is smaller than previously expected. Higher fuel costs, uncertain macroeconomic conditions, and the stock’s demanding valuation therefore support the Sell/High Risk recommendation.
